Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner prematurely locked onto the State of the World Forum as the target and defined its type as an “international dialogue forum” based on weak, non-authoritative sources, without checking other forums initiated by Mikhail Gorbachev. This missed the World Summit of Nobel Peace Laureates, whose type aligns with “a forum where organizations could come together to address global issues.” That mis-scoping steered all subsequent steps toward the wrong forum and thus the wrong answer.
